title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Competitive Methods - RFQ vs RFP
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: When comparing an RFQ (Request for Quotations) and an RFP (Request for Proposals), an RFQ is typically:
options: More structured, taking several months to evaluate
Used for highly complex consulting projects
An informal process for smaller dollar purchases that do not require complex evaluation
questions.explain: RFQs are simplified, informal processes used when the value of the procurement is below statutory formal thresholds, focusing generally on securing price quotes quickly.
